name: Homeground
genre: Longboard downhill physics on map tiles (TypeScript)
speedNote: One core, 16.53 s wall, 2670 simulated seconds per wall second.

events.verdict: not a bug: nose-first at rest, by design; pump while carving escapes
real design gap: no map boundary, the rider leaves the 1 km tile

replays.note: Every round with an event plus every 10th round, replayed from recorded inputs alone; hash and event list compared.

adapter: Board physics was already three.js-free with a fixed 120 Hz step. Real levels need the live tile server, so the adapter builds seeded synthetic tiles. About half a day.
notes: Persona rules (fighting vocabulary) were dropped; archetype, skill and reaction time carried over.
New action vocabulary and situation buckets: road, offroad, wall, air, bail.
A first "softlock" invariant gave 16 false positives; the game has no fail state, so not moving is a choice. It is now counted as "stalled", not a bug.
